shortDescription: Plan your next great eclipse — browse the catalogue, open the path on the map, and check local timing for any place you choose.
longDescription:
Plan your next great eclipse - or the one after that.

Browse a full catalogue of solar eclipses, then open the path on the map and check the local timing for any place you choose.

  • See centre lines, path limits, and coverage at a glance
  • Drop a pin for contact times, duration, and whether you’re in totality or annularity
  • Favourite, share, or add eclipses straight to your calendar

Clear maps. Precise times. No fuss.
